feeds.description: Exploring the hometowns and legacies of Hollywood's Golden Age stars. My name is Annette Bochenek and I am a film historian and perpetual scholar of Hollywood's Golden Age. Since the lives of many actors and actresses are well documented from their Hollywood careers onward, I find it fascinating to examine their lives prior to this time. I focus upon places of relevance to them during their early days, while also researching how their legacies are celebrated in their hometowns and beyond.
